name: Longsword
description: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d8 + 8) slashing damage plus 13 (3d8) lightning damage. If the creature scores a critical hit, it rolls damage dice three times, instead of twice.
